headline: Schema-valid extraction is not evidence fidelity. A naive structured-output baseline frequently produced valid-looking fields whose attached source quotes did not resolve exactly; candidate-first extraction was built to make that failure visible and reduce it through deterministic provenance.

heldout_engineering_run.how_to_read_this: The low exact-provenance pass rate is the baseline finding, not a defect in the repository. It quantifies how often schema-valid output lacked an attached quote that resolved verbatim. Deterministic span-ID recovery improves item-level auditability, but remaining abstentions and low case-level full-pass rates show this is not a solved grounding or semantic-entailment result.

decomposition_stress_diagnostic.task_selection: 200 failed exact-provenance evidence items from each of three held-out Cohere cells, selected from the lowest exact-provenance records.
decomposition_stress_diagnostic.query_aware_revision: Clause-aware quote splitting recovers generated pseudo-quotes that join admission/discharge snippets, slash-separated clauses, or source-heading-prefixed fragments. The original strict greedy token-union pass still runs first; relaxed greedy is used only after strict greedy fails. Target-aware assertion-cue scope checks then block only cues whose local scope overlaps the extracted item target, with a narrow lab/procedure exception for negative test results or uncomplicated procedures. Strict low-overlap review rescue accepts only short local spans with high quote coverage and meaningful label coverage, and routes those cases to review-required support. A label-only risk guard abstains when label-only support is diffuse, cross-section, or low-quote-coverage.

full_failed_exact_pool_validation.task_selection: All failed exact-provenance evidence items selected by the runner across the same three held-out cells. This pool includes easier exact-match failures than the 600-item hard slice and is reported as a scaling check, not as a population estimate.
full_failed_exact_pool_validation.interpretation: The full-pool run shows that the stricter label-only risk guard removes high-risk supported items at scale while preserving most query-aware support. It should not be read as an easier headline replacement for the hard-slice stress result.

decomposition_stress_diagnostic.interpretation: Expanded targeted decomposition still favors query-aware multi-span retrieval over full-note normalization and one-span baselines. In the 600-item hard slice from the lowest-performing held-out records, query-aware support reaches 395/600, with 238 auto-accepted supports, 157 review-required supports, 205 abstentions, and 0 high-risk supported items. Strict low-overlap review rescue adds only 3 supported items in this expanded run, all review-required. The full failed-exact pool then scales the same policy to 13,038 items: query-aware support reaches 11,001/13,038, with 7,829 auto-accepted supports, 3,172 review-required supports, 2,037 abstentions, and 0 high-risk supported items after converting 332 diffuse label-only unions to abstentions. The remaining failures show that the result is parsing-policy failure analysis, not semantic factuality, population prevalence, or proof that note length causally drives errors.

candidate_first_v4_final_rerun.interpretation: strongest current engineering architecture; over-extraction unresolved

candidate_first_v4_stability.interpretation: passed deterministic gates, but model-selected ambiguous candidates are not perfectly repeatable

candidate_first_v4_source_fidelity_audit.interpretation: deterministic extractive summaries removed unsupported numeric-detail leakage; remaining issues require factual review

claims_boundary: Aggregate engineering and proxy evidence only; no clinical accuracy, safety, appropriateness, harmfulness, or generalizability claim.
